findings.summary: negative_control_log names negative-control-this-round.log, whose last line is EXIT=0, so the mutation the node declares was never shown to fail; reckon crew check --manifest on this run returns ok:false with reckon/crew/reports.py:2535's refusal, so the run cannot be admitted until the line names a red log such as negative-control-before-both.log, which ends EXIT=1 with reuse and figure both FAIL.

the sentence names revision 9bc7839053 as the one where the release pass read the fleet's node through a one-line wrapper, but 9bc7839 is the commit that deleted that wrapper, so the durable record attributes the superseded reading to the revision that removed it; p11 of the same fragment records the sequence correctly.

nothing committed verifies the figure this line saves, so the outline form the round repaired has no guard in the suite; the assertion lives only in check_findings.py, which is not in the repository and is no longer on disk, so a hand-edit or a revert to font-referenced text restores the exact defect this commit repaired with no test reddening.
